title: Roaming will not put doubt out
summary: Distance and novelty cannot do what the Guru must do. Stop roaming and let inner filth be named.
takeaway: Stop roaming and let inner filth be named.
lifeApplication: When escape starts sounding spiritual, stay still long enough for the real fire and the inner filth to be seen.
